intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Beetroot-burgers and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: While beetroot itself is gluten-free, the overall safety of beetroot-burgers depends on the other ingredients and preparation methods used, which may introduce gluten risks. Care should be taken to ensure no gluten-containing ingredients are included and that cross-contamination is avoided.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.
